title: Cuadrícula de Storyboard de 20 Paneles: Plantilla Animática Minimalista para Anime Japonés y Cine Escandinavo
prompt: A 20-panel storyboard grid layout with numbered frames from 1 to 20, designed in the style of a minimalist animatic sketch for Japanese anime and Scandinavian film planning. The storyboard features simple, generic grey figures with thick black outlines and crosshairs on their faces to indicate viewing direction and camera focus. The panels demonstrate various cinematic compositions including wide establishing shots of Nordic fjords and Japanese city streets, intimate close-ups, dramatic high angles looking down from Tokyo skyscrapers, and low angles emphasizing character presence. The art style is monochrome with flat greyscale tones, executed in a clean schematic drawing style reminiscent of Studio Ghibli pre-production sketches and Danish animation planning templates, presented as a digital sketch template for film production.
